findingDetails.title: The hook brief renders a child-supplied command without the owner check the CLI path applies
findingDetails.scopeProof: print site render.ts:231; unvetted input via skill-advisor-brief.ts:541 and subprocess.ts:187; vetted sibling skill-advisor-cli.ts:1571
findingDetails.claim: REQ-038's owner check is applied on the CLI degraded path but not on the hook brief path, so a child-supplied command and policy render unvetted there.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: parseRecommendations accepts any non-empty command string; commandLabel performs only sanitizeSkillLabel and a mutating-class lookup; the Python command field comes from its own table, which is why the case is table drift rather than prompt injection.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: both command tables are generated from one source, so they cannot drift and the missing check cannot print a foreign command
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a generator or test proves both tables come from one shared source and cannot drift

results.summary: REQ-038's owner check and the deep commands' ask policy are confirmed on the CLI path; the hook path gap is the new P2.

noveltyJustification: First security pass: one new P2 for a consumer of the child boundary that the twelfth round's hardening did not cover; every other trust-boundary probe was confirmed clean or ruled out.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: the child-process boundary and both degraded brief consumers are non-trivial surfaces

targetSelection.selectionReason: the two degraded brief consumers of the child-process output and the renderer that prints it
